meta.title: dsh-argp
meta.description: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + seq-addressed recall from an append-only log (text verbatim; structured params are JSON semantic-equivalent reconstructions). Compaction targets converge on a character-count basis; originals stay in the log.
